subject: Next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@acme-energy.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Redwood pilot

Hi Sofia — great speaking earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot stood up quickly: 

- Goal: 2-week pilot to validate latency/cost for Acme's customer-facing summarization flow.
- Key success criteria we heard: per-request latency < 300ms 95th, cost target <$0.006/1000 tokens, and support for private deployment options for production.

To move forward we typically coordinate across three parallel tracks: 1) commercial/PO, 2) legal/contract routing (NDA -> MSA + DPA), and 3) security/compliance review (SOC2 artifacts, questionnaire). Can you confirm owners for the following? 

- Economic buyer / budget sign-off: (who at Acme will sign the PO?)
- Legal owner for MSAs and redlines (name & email)
- Procurement owner for purchase orders and vendor setup
- Security contact for SOC2/pen-test evidence and questionnaire

Suggested sequencing (can adjust based on your preference): 
1) NDA (if you want one) — quick agreement so we can share production-level artifacts (turn: 1–3 business days).
2) MSA with DPA as an annex — legal redlines and comments, then DocuSign for signatures (turn: typically 1–3 weeks depending on redlines).
3) Procurement vendor/PO setup in parallel (procurement timelines vary).

I've attached a draft MSA and a template NDA for your legal team to review. If you can share the names/emails and an expected turnaround for each owner, I'll coordinate internally and surface a mutual action plan. Would also love to set a 30-min alignment next week to walk the sequence with your legal/procurement folks.

Next steps for us: I'll loop in our security lead (Neha) to own the SOC2/technical artifacts and our solutions engineer (Priyom) for any technical clarifications during legal review.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: MSA_Redwood_v1.docx] [Attachment: NDA_Redwood_Acme.pdf]

Cc: Tom Williams <tom.williams@acme-energy.com>, Leah Brooks <leah.brooks@acme-energy.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-energy.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Redwood pilot

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming owners below: 

- Economic buyer / budget: Tom Williams (CFO) — tom.williams@acme-energy.com
- Legal owner: Leah Brooks (Head of Legal) — leah.brooks@acme-energy.com
- Procurement: Raj Patel (Vendor Mgmt) — raj.patel@acme-energy.com
- Security contact: Miguel Santos (InfoSec) — miguel.santos@acme-energy.com (I can loop him in once we have NDA/MA)

Estimated turn times: procurement vendor setup ~4–6 weeks (standard for us), legal review of MSA typically 1–2 weeks depending on redlines, and security initial intake can usually respond within 3–5 business days once Miguel has the SOC2 artifacts and questionnaire.

We would prefer NDA first so Miguel can review the SOC2 report and the draft integration architecture. Please send the NDA and a redlineable MSA. Also — will Leah expect a fully negotiated MSA or do you accept redlines in stages (e.g., contractual skeleton + then technical SAs/DPA annex)?

Sofia Ramirez
Head of Product Partnerships | Acme Energy
sofia.ramirez@acme-energy.com | (212) 555-6789

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@acme-energy.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Redwood pilot

Perfect — thanks for the owners and the timeline context. A few clarifications and proposals: 

- NDA first: we’ll request Leah/Tom/Raj to sign the mutual NDA so we can share SOC2 and the integration diagram. Turn: we can push the NDA through DocuSign (48 hrs typical).
- MSA sequencing: we usually accept staged redlines. Recommendation: Leah can start on a skeleton MSA (commercial terms + core liabilities) and then we incorporate a DPA annex that captures data processing/security obligations. That tends to reduce back-and-forth. If Acme prefers a full negotiated MSA up-front we can accommodate but it usually lengthens the cycle.
- Procurement: we’ll provide our vendor setup packet (W-9, insurance certs, bank details) to Raj in parallel.

I’ve uploaded the following for your review and shared DocuSign links: 
- NDA_Redwood_Acme.pdf (recommended mutual NDA)
- MSA_Redwood_v1.docx (clean copy + commentable version)

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890
DocuSign (NDA): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?envelopeId=ABC123

If it helps, I can schedule a 30-min call Tues or Wed to walk Leah and Miguel through the MSA skeleton and technical attachments so we can align on expected redline items. Proposed owners internally that will be on the thread: 
- Legal/commercial: David Kim (legal liaison) — david.kim@redwood.com
- Solutions / technical: Priyom Das — priyom.das@redwood.com
- Security: Neha Kapoor — neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Let me know available times and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa
[Attachment: NDA_Redwood_Acme.pdf]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Redwood pilot (security artifacts)

Looping in a quick security note for the thread: happy to own the security intake and initial review for Acme. To accelerate Miguel’s review, please confirm we can share the following under NDA: 

- SOC2 Type II report (2025) — attached stub here.
- Pen test summary (redacted) + remediation status.
- Data flow diagram and where keys are managed (KMS/HSM).
- Answers to a short 10–15 question security questionnaire (I can fill this out and share).

Turn times: I can commit to an initial security intake and findings within 3 business days of receiving the SOC2 and pen test summary; deeper remediation/Q&A may take longer. If Acme needs a security questionnaire up-front, I can provide our template and fill the sections that are standard.

Attachment: SOC2-report-2025.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — this works for us. Quick agreement on immediate next steps: 

1) We’ll execute the mutual NDA via the DocuSign link you shared (Marissa) today.
2) Miguel will intake the SOC2 + pen test summary once NDA is complete; expect initial findings within 3–5 business days.
3) Leah will have procurement looped for the MSA; we’ll start with the skeleton MSA + DPA annex approach you suggested — Leah estimates 1–2 weeks for initial redlines.
4) Raj will begin vendor setup in parallel (4–6 weeks).

Can you please: 
- Confirm you’ve sent the vendor packet to Raj (W-9, insurance certs).
- Send a proposed 30-min slot for next Tue/Wed for a quick legal + security walk-through.

Appreciate the coordination — looking forward to getting this running.

Sofia
